# Since we XOR: (edx & 0xff) ^ input[i] == expected[i]
# Therefore: input[i] = (edx & 0xff) ^ expected[i]

result = []

    # Extract low byte of edx
    edx_low = edx & 0xff
    # input[i] = edx_low ^ expected[i]
    c = edx_low ^ expected[i]
    result.append(c)
    # Update edx by adding input[i] (this is 32-bit addition)
    edx = (edx + c) & 0xffffffff
